description: List the videos in one tab of the user's SpyWinAds account (only videos the user's own app found). Give tab (a built-in tab) or custom_tab_id (a tab the user saved, from spywin_list_my_custom_tabs; same videos and filters as that tab in the app). Each video: product line from the ad, full ad text, store domain, the day the video file first appeared on Facebook (or first ad if unknown), age in days, days running, live ads, total ads seen, stores running it now, first ad date, landing page. Up to 50 per page; use page for more.

custom_tab_id.description: id of a saved tab from spywin_list_my_custom_tabs, instead of tab

max_age_days.description: Only videos whose file / first ad is at most this many days old

max_stores.description: Only videos run by at most this many stores now

min_days_running.description: Only videos whose first ad is at least this many days old and still have a live ad

min_stores.description: Only videos run by at least this many stores now

sort.description: strongest (same order as the app; default for custom tabs), stores (default for built-in tabs), newest, ads (built-in tabs only)

tab.description: win, potential, scale, cash_cow, followed, testing, deep_dig or all

name: spywin_list_my_videos
title: My videos by tab
